purpose: MN population -> joint drive for the typing circuit. Joint target = rest + g_j * (sum agonist MN rate - sum antagonist MN rate); g_j, offset learned per joint (28 params).

match.mn_type: MN type string (npz mn_type), restricted to MNs whose mn_side equals joint side (L drives LF, R drives RF); all nerves (ProLN and T1 other-nerve MNs) count

sign_convention: Agonist minus antagonist is the nominal positive direction of the joint's movement text, but the sign relative to the MuJoCo joint axis is NOT verified; the learned gain g_j has free sign so it absorbs this. Review before trusting sign.
fallback_policy: A joint with status 'fallback' has no MN drive; the env must use its rest+learned bias or IK/imitation output. Currently none: all 14 joints have MN coverage, but see confidence.

joint_LFCoxa_yaw.movement: leg abduction (+) / adduction (-) about the body-axis (x) hinge
joint_LFCoxa_yaw.note: Pleural remotor/abductor MN is dual-function (also antagonist of the coxa promotor); Sternal adductor MN has only 1 neuron per side.

joint_LFCoxa.movement: coxa promotion (+) / remotion (-), pitch about y
joint_LFCoxa.note: Promotor 4 neurons per side; remotor 2 per side. Names follow Azevedo et al. 2020 leg-muscle nomenclature; direction vs NeuroMechFly sign is unverified.

joint_LFCoxa_roll.movement: coxa rotation about its long axis (z)

joint_LFFemur.note: Trochanter and femur are fused in the fly, so trochanter muscles drive the model's Femur pitch. Sternotrochanter MN / Tergotr. MN are left unmapped (uncertain action).

joint_LFFemur_roll.movement: femur rotation about its long axis (z)
joint_LFFemur_roll.note: One-sided: no annotated antagonist roll muscle; Fe reductor action on the roll DOF is an assumption. Antagonism comes from the position actuator's spring.

joint_LFTibia.note: Long-tendon-muscle (ltm) MNs pull the tibia flexor tendon.

joint_LFTarsus1.note: Only Tarsus1 is an actuated joint; Tarsus2-5 are fixed/baked in the model.

joint_RFCoxa_yaw.movement: leg abduction (+) / adduction (-) about the body-axis (x) hinge
joint_RFCoxa_yaw.note: Pleural remotor/abductor MN is dual-function (also antagonist of the coxa promotor); Sternal adductor MN has only 1 neuron per side.

joint_RFCoxa.note: Promotor 4 neurons per side; remotor 2 per side. Names follow Azevedo et al. 2020 leg-muscle nomenclature; direction vs NeuroMechFly sign is unverified.

joint_RFCoxa_roll.movement: coxa rotation about its long axis (z)

joint_RFFemur.note: Trochanter and femur are fused in the fly, so trochanter muscles drive the model's Femur pitch. Sternotrochanter MN / Tergotr. MN are left unmapped (uncertain action).

joint_RFFemur_roll.movement: femur rotation about its long axis (z)
joint_RFFemur_roll.note: One-sided: no annotated antagonist roll muscle; Fe reductor action on the roll DOF is an assumption. Antagonism comes from the position actuator's spring.

joint_RFTibia.note: Long-tendon-muscle (ltm) MNs pull the tibia flexor tendon.

review_note: Reviewed against MaleCNS v1.0 annotations (types on ProLN, ProAN, VProN, DProN nerves) and NeuroMechFly leg_dofs [Coxa_yaw, Coxa, Coxa_roll, Femur, Femur_roll, Tibia, Tarsus1]. Distal joints (Tibia, Tarsus1, Femur) have well-established antagonist pairs. Coxa and Femur_roll assignments come from muscle names only (no functional data) and need anatomical review; MN counts are 1-4 neurons per type per side. Two right ProLN MNs have no type annotation and are unmapped.
